title: Universal-cover products for integrable tangent summands
exact_target: Let X be a connected compact Kähler manifold with $T_X=V_{1}\oplus V_{2}$ a decomposition into holomorphic integrable subbundles. Must its universal cover split biholomorphically as $Y_{1}×Y_{2}$ so that the lifted $V_i$ is the tangent bundle along the corresponding factor?
